g.text: Scientific Return — the exclusively full-agentic flow
Start autonomous discovery for a watch
The deterministic run finishes and chains
Is there already a cycle for the same key?
Is a cycle already live for the same target?
Persist the budget and the durable envelope
Dispatch to Cloud Tasks or to the database queue
Acquire an atomic lease with a unique worker_id
End the duplicate delivery without running any tool
Does the lease belong to another worker?
Retrieve ACTIVE curatorial memory for that
object's inventory number, under a global
limit and scoped to the institution
Reserve a deterministic floor of at most half
the query budget: author surname + object and
the bare inventory code, run before any plan
The LLM planner receives the snapshot,
Persist the plan in the encrypted trajectory
Call Crossref, Europe PMC or OpenAlex
Apply a global per-source rate limit
Persist the query and the returned count
Cache metadata and a hash for replay
The LLM reader receives trusted context
and the publication as untrusted data
Link the candidate with an idempotent upsert
Record the analysis and its agentic provenance
Record an ERROR for the article
Is there a record still unassessed?
Update budget usage and the iteration summary
Does the agent want to continue,
with no cancellation and budget left?
Close the run-envelope and the investigation as COMPLETED
Notify the watch owner if the run
End without touching the curatorial queue
For candidates left without inventory evidence,
Show the candidate, source, query, passage,
Record the decision and its justification
Turn the free explanation into a PROPOSED lesson
The curator reviews, edits or activates the proposal
Make the example available to future cycles
Should the feedback teach the agent?
Planning and reading by an LLM
